name: Mentor/Apprentice Program (Live Arts)
what_you_do: High school students are paired with expert stage designers and stage managers. You get hands-on training in the work behind the scenes at a theater.
who_can_apply: High school students. No other rules are listed.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The education page looked out of date when read (it said spring 2026 information was coming soon).
how_to_apply: Not stated. Contact Education Director Daniel Kunkel. Use the contact link on the Live Arts education page.
notes: The page gives no dates, cost, or application. Confirm the program still runs. Live Arts also lists Teen Studio (ages 14 to 18) as a class, not a job.
